tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description:
Search live WhatJobs job listings by role and place.

Use this when the user wants to find jobs, vacancies, internships or other work, or asks to see more results from a job search.

Inputs:
- keyword: the role, job function, skill or industry only. Leave out the place and filler words such as jobs,

tools.name: get_salary_insights
tools.description:
Show what a job pays, from the salaries in current WhatJobs listings: typical range, median, lowest and highest, plus a few listings with salaries.

Use this when the user asks how much a role pays or earns, salary ranges, or whether a salary is good, e.g. "How much does a nurse earn in Paris?" or "

tools.name: compare_salaries
tools.description:
Compare what a job pays across places, or what different jobs pay in one place, from the salaries in current WhatJobs listings: the typical range and median for each, side by side.

Use this when the user wants pay compared, e.g. "Nurse salary in London vs Manchester", "Do developers earn more in Be

tools.name: get_top_hiring_companies
tools.description:
List the companies posting the most jobs for a role and place right now on WhatJobs, with their job counts and example listings.

Use this when the user asks who is hiring, which companies or employers have openings, or the biggest employers for a role, e.g. "Who's hiring software engineers in Berli

tools.name: compare_job_counts
tools.description:
Compare how many jobs are live on WhatJobs right now across places and/or roles.

Use this when the user asks where the most jobs are, how much demand there is, or to compare cities or roles, e.g. "Where are the most data analyst jobs in Germany?", "More jobs for nurses or carers in Leeds?", "Paris

tools.name: search_latest_jobs
tools.description:
Show only recently posted WhatJobs listings for a role and place, newest first.

Use this when the user asks for new, fresh, recent or today's jobs, e.g. "Any electrician jobs posted today in Manchester?" or "New marketing jobs this week in Madrid".

Inputs:
- keyword: the job role only.
- location:

tools.name: match_jobs_to_profile
tools.description:
Find WhatJobs listings that fit a person's background: searches up to 4 target job titles at once and ranks the jobs by how well the title matches and how many of their skills each listing mentions.

Use this when the user shares their CV, experience or skills and asks what jobs suit them, e.g. "Her

tools.name: report_view_status
tools.description: Records whether the WhatJobs results view finished loading, so loading problems can be found. Called by the results view itself, not by the assistant. Inputs: status (loaded or failed), kind (the type of result shown) and query (the search that result shows).
